description: Apply to one job on the user's behalf. Pass job_match_id from getmattered_get_matches, or job_url for any posting. GetMattered rewrites the resume and cover letter for that role, then completes and submits the application on the employer's own hiring system (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Personio, Teamtailor, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Breezy, Workable, Rippling, BambooHR, JazzHR, softgarden, Jobvite, Gem, Zoho Recruit, Dayforce, Hireology, Dover, Oracle Recruiting Cloud, Paylocity, Oracle Taleo, UKG Pro Recruiting, ADP, Avature, CareerPlug, Pinpoint, Manatal, and Eightfold). A job_url on another hiring system is saved to the user's tracker to apply by hand, and nothing is sent. When outcome is not_applied, tell the user the reason and userAction, and do not try other links for the same job. mode "auto" submits with no review step; mode "review" prepares everything and holds it for the user's approval; omit mode to follow the review setting on the user's account. The mode applies to this one application and never changes the user's settings. Spends one of the user's applications and AI credits, and a submitted application cannot be withdrawn, so apply only to jobs the user chose. Returns the application id and a tracking link; when the job already has an application, that one comes back with alreadyExisted true instead of a second. On a timeout or an error, call getmattered_get_applications before retrying, and never re-apply by job_url to a job already applied to by job_match_id. Do not use it to save or skip a match; use getmattered_save_matches or getmattered_skip_matches. Next: getmattered_get_applications to follow it, and getmattered_approve_applications if it waits for approval. Apply to one job per call, and make one call at a time.

job_match_id.description: The job_match_id of a match from getmattered_get_matches (e.g. 48213). Pass this OR job_url.

job_url.description: URL of any job posting to apply to (e.g. "https://boards.greenhouse.io/acme/jobs/123"). Pass this OR job_match_id. When the job is in getmattered_get_matches, pass its job_match_id instead.

mode.description: "auto" submits with no review step. "review" holds the prepared application for the user's approval. Omit to follow the user's account setting. Applies to this application only.

name: getmattered_apply

alreadyExisted.description: True when this job already had an application, which is returned instead of a second one.

applicationId.description: The application to follow with getmattered_get_applications. Null only when nothing was started.

host.description: The host of the job_url, when one was given.

outcome.description: started: a new application; already_in_progress: this job already had one (alreadyExisted); not_confirmed: the user declined, nothing was sent; not_applied: nothing was sent, see reason and userAction.

reason.description: Null when a new application started. unsupported_host: GetMattered does not submit on that hiring system, the job was saved to the tracker for the user to apply on the employer site. posting_not_found: the employer has no posting at that link. import_failed: the posting could not be read or saved. already_applied: this job already has an application. Do not retry with other URLs for the same job.

status.description: Our own record. Never proof the employer received it.

userAction.description: What the user can do next, ready to tell them. Null when a new application started.

title: Apply to Job
